provenance.method: Algorithm parameters transcribed from the legacy NECB2020 water_heater_mixed_apply_efficiency and auto_size_shw_capacity, cross-verified against NECB 2020 Table 6.2.2.1 via the building-codes MCP (electric standby-loss formulas, gas-fired storage UEF ladders by tank volume + first-hour rating, Et >= 90% + SL formula for large equipment, oil rows). SHW demand data (peak flows, temperatures, schedules) lives in the openstudio-loads space-type records. Runtime never contacts the MCP.
provenance.reference_article: 8.4.4.20: reference SWH identical to proposed (storage capacity, power input, energy type); HP-source SWH -> air-source HP. Sentences (3)-(4) fall in an extraction gap of the source PDF chunking — treated as Part 6 minimums (coverage: partial).

autosize.note: pump head uses the OpenStudio constant-speed default (legacy default path); the legacy geometric mech-room piping-run head calculation is a documented future

efficiency.fhr_l_per_hr: 0.7 x tank_volume_litres + 151.0 (legacy first-hour-rating rule of thumb)

maguire_roberts.recovery_efficiency: eff + q_load x (uef - eff) / (24 x cap_btu_hr x uef)

articles.title: Service water heater performance (Table 6.2.2.1)
articles.how: electric storage (SL formulas), gas-fired storage (UEF ladders + Et>=90%/SL for large) and oil (via the gas path, legacy behavior) implemented on WaterHeaterMixed with Maguire-Roberts UA derivation; instantaneous rows (gas UEF 0.86 conservative / Et 0.94, oil Et 0.80, tankless zero UA) and storage heat-pump water heaters (WaterHeaterHeatPump build + code EF/UEF floor as rated COP) implemented
articles.gaps: solar-thermal and pool-heater classes not modeled (legacy scope); HPWH uses the bounded pumped-condenser construction (upstream stratified-tank/EMS recipe not ported)

articles.title: SWH controls, piping insulation, pools, booster heaters
articles.gaps: piping insulation, temperature maintenance controls, pool covers etc. not modeled (legacy scope)

articles.title: Service water heating loads representative of the building

articles.title: Reference SWH identical to proposed (storage, power, energy type)

articles.title: Remaining reference SWH sentences
articles.how: (3)/(4) verified against the full article text (retrieved via MCP 2026-07-28 after the ingestion fix): the umbrella's clone preserves the boiler-fed immersion coil's energy type ((3)) and the multi-energy capacity allocation and operating schedules identically — trivially matching the (4)(a) ratio (Note A-8.4.4.20.(4)(a) merely says how to determine it) and (4)(b) operational characteristics. Part 6 minimum efficiencies applied on top via apply_efficiency.
articles.gaps: REFINED after machine-verification (D-41): the former 'PDF-extraction chunk gap' is closed — (3)/(4)/(6)/(7)/(8) are satisfied by clone. Remaining real gaps: (5) 8.4.5 part-load performance curves are not applied to reference SWH equipment, and (9) multiple proposed circulation pumps are not consolidated into a single constant-speed pump (the clone keeps identical W/(L/s) — energy-equivalent, topology differs).

articles.title: General — SWH components accounted
articles.how: Service water heating accounted per the prescriptive Section 6.2 requirements via the reference SHW transform (8.4.4.20.) and heater efficiency application — the realization of 8.4.1.1.(1) for the SWH slice.
